README.title: PathSaarthi Gujarat — MongoDB Career Seed Dataset
README.important: Starter dataset for development only. Career demand labels are not live labour-market rankings. Qualification routes are general descriptions and MUST be checked against official sources before publishing. YouTube links are search links, not endorsements or reviewed videos.
README.suggestedUse: Import into a development MongoDB database, review each document, add source records/URLs and verification dates, then change status to published only after human review.
README.skillsNote: Career-specific skill names, descriptions, and practice projects are populated for all 26 careers. Content is a starter draft and should be reviewed by subject experts before publication.

skills.name: Programming fundamentals
skills.whyItMatters: Variables, data types, conditions, loops, functions, and problem solving.
skills.practiceProject: Build a command-line expense tracker.

skills.name: Data structures and algorithms
skills.whyItMatters: Arrays, strings, maps, stacks, queues, sorting, searching, and complexity basics.
skills.practiceProject: Solve 25 beginner problems and explain the approach.

skills.name: Web development and APIs
skills.whyItMatters: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, HTTP, REST APIs, and one backend framework.
skills.practiceProject: Build a responsive CRUD task manager using an API.

skills.name: Git, testing, and deployment
skills.whyItMatters: Git branches, code review, unit tests, environment variables, and deployment.
skills.practiceProject: Deploy a full-stack app with README and tests.

skills.name: Spreadsheet analysis
skills.whyItMatters: Clean data, formulas, pivot tables, lookups, and charts.
skills.practiceProject: Analyse a monthly sales spreadsheet and present 3 findings.

skills.name: SQL querying
skills.whyItMatters: SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY, subqueries, and window functions.
skills.practiceProject: Answer 10 business questions from a sample sales database.

skills.name: Statistics and data cleaning
skills.whyItMatters: Descriptive statistics, missing values, outliers, sampling, and correlation.
skills.practiceProject: Clean a public dataset and document assumptions.

skills.name: Dashboard storytelling
skills.whyItMatters: Power BI or Tableau, KPI design, filters, and concise insight writing.
skills.practiceProject: Create a dashboard with 5 KPIs and an executive summary.

skills.name: Python for data work
skills.whyItMatters: Python, functions, collections, NumPy, pandas, and notebooks.
skills.practiceProject: Explore and clean a tabular dataset.

skills.name: Math and statistics foundations
skills.whyItMatters: Linear algebra basics, probability, distributions, gradients, and evaluation metrics.
skills.practiceProject: Explain mean, variance, and precision/recall with examples.

skills.name: Machine learning workflow
skills.whyItMatters: Train/validation/test split, feature engineering, baselines, and model evaluation.
skills.practiceProject: Train and compare two models on a labelled dataset.

skills.name: Model deployment and responsible AI
skills.whyItMatters: Build an inference API, track experiments, check bias, and document limitations.
skills.practiceProject: Deploy a small model API with a model card.

skills.name: Networking fundamentals
skills.whyItMatters: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, ports, routing, and common network protocols.
skills.practiceProject: Draw and explain a home-network traffic flow.

skills.name: Linux and scripting
skills.whyItMatters: Linux CLI, permissions, logs, Bash/Python automation.
skills.practiceProject: Write a script that summarises failed login events.

skills.name: Security monitoring
skills.whyItMatters: Authentication logs, SIEM concepts, alerts, indicators, and incident triage.
skills.practiceProject: Analyse a provided sample log and write a short incident report.

skills.name: Security fundamentals and ethics
skills.whyItMatters: Threat modelling, access control, encryption basics, safe lab practice, and responsible disclosure.
skills.practiceProject: Create a threat model for a demo web application.

skills.name: Linux and networking
skills.whyItMatters: Shell, processes, permissions, DNS, ports, SSH, and troubleshooting.
skills.practiceProject: Provision a Linux VM and document its setup.

skills.name: Git and CI/CD
skills.whyItMatters: Git workflows, automated tests, build pipelines, and release practices.
skills.practiceProject: Create a pipeline that tests a sample application.

skills.practiceProject: Containerise a small API and run it locally.

skills.name: Cloud, infrastructure, and monitoring

skills.practiceProject: Deploy a demo app with health checks and a cost note.

skills.name: User research

skills.practiceProject: Interview 3 users and summarise recurring pain points.

skills.name: Information architecture

skills.practiceProject: Map the flow for a student career-search journey.

skills.name: Wireframing and prototyping

skills.practiceProject: Prototype a mobile-first career guidance screen.

skills.name: Usability and accessibility
skills.whyItMatters: Usability tests, contrast, keyboard navigation, readable typography, and iteration.
skills.practiceProject: Test a prototype with 5 tasks and prioritise fixes.

skills.name: Audience and content strategy
skills.whyItMatters: Audience research, positioning, content pillars, and campaign objectives.
skills.practiceProject: Create a 2-week content calendar for a local business.

skills.name: SEO fundamentals
skills.whyItMatters: Search intent, keyword research, on-page SEO, metadata, and technical basics.
skills.practiceProject: Optimise a sample page for one relevant search query.

skills.name: Social and paid campaigns
skills.whyItMatters: Platform formats, creative testing, campaign setup, and budget basics.
skills.practiceProject: Design two ad variants with a clear hypothesis.

skills.name: Analytics and reporting
skills.whyItMatters: UTM tags, conversion funnels, CTR, CPC, and evidence-based reporting.
skills.practiceProject: Build a campaign report with metrics and next steps.

skills.name: Accounting principles
skills.whyItMatters: Journal entries, ledgers, trial balance, financial statements, and reconciliation.
skills.practiceProject: Prepare basic statements from sample transactions.

skills.name: Taxation fundamentals
skills.whyItMatters: Understand direct/indirect tax concepts and verify current rules from official sources.
skills.practiceProject: Prepare a learning-only tax case using a published example.

skills.name: Audit and internal controls
skills.whyItMatters: Audit evidence, documentation, risk, sampling, and control testing concepts.
skills.practiceProject: Draft a mock internal-control checklist.

skills.name: Financial analysis and ethics
skills.whyItMatters: Ratio analysis, working capital, professional ethics, and confidentiality.
skills.practiceProject: Compare two sample companies using financial ratios.

skills.name: Financial statements
skills.whyItMatters: Read income statements, balance sheets, cash flows, and footnotes.
skills.practiceProject: Summarise a listed company’s annual report.

skills.name: Excel and financial modelling
skills.whyItMatters: Formulas, lookups, scenario analysis, forecasts, and model checks.
skills.practiceProject: Build a simple revenue and expense forecast.

skills.name: Valuation fundamentals
skills.whyItMatters: Time value of money, discounted cash flow, multiples, and assumptions.
skills.practiceProject: Create a learning-only DCF model with sensitivity analysis.

skills.name: Research and communication
skills.whyItMatters: Industry research, source evaluation, charts, and concise investment-style writing.
skills.practiceProject: Write a one-page company analysis with sources and risks.

skills.name: Requirements elicitation
skills.whyItMatters: Stakeholder interviews, observation, workshops, and clarifying questions.
skills.practiceProject: Write requirements for a college admission portal.

skills.name: Process mapping
skills.whyItMatters: As-is/to-be flows, BPMN basics, bottlenecks, and exception paths.
skills.practiceProject: Map an application approval process.

skills.name: Data and SQL basics
skills.whyItMatters: Spreadsheets, basic SQL, metrics, and data validation.
skills.practiceProject: Create a small KPI report from sample records.

skills.name: Specifications and acceptance criteria
skills.whyItMatters: User stories, functional requirements, acceptance tests, and traceability.
skills.practiceProject: Write 5 user stories with acceptance criteria.

skills.name: Customer discovery
skills.whyItMatters: User interviews, problem framing, personas, and evidence vs assumptions.
skills.practiceProject: Interview users and write a problem statement.

skills.name: Prioritisation and product strategy
skills.whyItMatters: Outcomes, opportunity sizing, trade-offs, roadmaps, and prioritisation methods.
skills.practiceProject: Rank 10 feature requests with a clear rationale.

skills.name: Metrics and experimentation
skills.whyItMatters: North-star metrics, funnels, hypotheses, A/B test concepts, and guardrails.
skills.practiceProject: Define success metrics for a new feature.

skills.name: Cross-functional execution
skills.whyItMatters: Product briefs, backlog refinement, stakeholder updates, and launch planning.
skills.practiceProject: Write a one-page PRD for a simple feature.

skills.name: Biology and chemistry foundations
skills.whyItMatters: Build school-level biology, chemistry, physics, and scientific reasoning for entrance preparation.
skills.practiceProject: Create a weekly topic and revision tracker.

skills.name: Evidence-based learning
skills.whyItMatters: Active recall, spaced repetition, diagram practice, and interpreting basic scientific evidence.
skills.practiceProject: Make flashcards and explain one body system.

skills.name: Communication and empathy
skills.whyItMatters: Listening, clear explanations, consent, confidentiality, and respectful interaction.
skills.practiceProject: Practise explaining a health concept in plain language.

skills.name: Clinical professionalism

skills.practiceProject: Review a fictional case and list safety questions.

skills.name: Human anatomy and physiology
skills.whyItMatters: Understand major body systems and normal physiological functions.
skills.practiceProject: Create labelled revision diagrams of major systems.

skills.name: Patient care fundamentals
skills.whyItMatters: Learn supervised care principles, hygiene, observation, comfort, and patient dignity.
skills.practiceProject: Prepare a patient-care checklist for study use.

skills.name: Communication and documentation
skills.whyItMatters: Handover, accurate notes, teamwork, privacy, and communicating concerns.
skills.practiceProject: Practise a structured handover using a fictional case.

skills.name: Safety and infection prevention
skills.whyItMatters: Hand hygiene, PPE concepts, infection control, and escalation procedures.
skills.practiceProject: Create a safety checklist based on official training material.

skills.name: Pharmaceutical science foundations
skills.whyItMatters: Basic chemistry, human biology, dosage forms, and medicine terminology.
skills.practiceProject: Create a study glossary of common dosage forms.

skills.name: Pharmacology and medicine safety
skills.whyItMatters: Learn drug classes, mechanisms, interactions, adverse effects, and the need for professional verification.
skills.practiceProject: Build a study table for selected drug classes.

skills.name: Dispensing and prescription literacy
skills.whyItMatters: Understand prescription components, labelling, storage, and when to refer questions to a qualified professional.
skills.practiceProject: Review a fictional prescription for completeness, not treatment advice.

skills.name: Regulation and patient communication
skills.whyItMatters: Professional ethics, documentation, counselling principles, and current regulatory requirements.
skills.practiceProject: Write a plain-language medicine-safety information sheet.

skills.name: Psychology foundations
skills.whyItMatters: Core concepts in cognition, development, learning, social behaviour, and research methods.
skills.practiceProject: Summarise one introductory psychology study.

skills.name: Research literacy and statistics
skills.whyItMatters: Study design, sampling, reliability, validity, correlation, and ethics.
skills.practiceProject: Critically review a published study’s method.

skills.name: Listening and communication
skills.whyItMatters: Empathy, non-judgmental listening, boundaries, and clear communication.
skills.practiceProject: Practise reflective listening with a role-play scenario.

skills.name: Ethics and professional pathways
skills.whyItMatters: Confidentiality, consent, referral boundaries, and verifying required qualifications for the chosen psychology role.
skills.practiceProject: Compare official qualification routes for two psychology roles.

skills.name: Legal research
skills.whyItMatters: Find legislation, judgments, rules, and authoritative sources; track jurisdiction and date.
skills.practiceProject: Prepare a source list for a simple legal topic.

skills.name: Reading and interpreting law
skills.whyItMatters: Identify facts, issues, rules, reasoning, and holdings in a judgment.
skills.practiceProject: Write a case brief for a publicly available judgment.

skills.name: Legal writing and argument
skills.whyItMatters: Structure clear arguments, cite sources, distinguish facts from opinions.
skills.practiceProject: Draft a short issue-rule-application-conclusion note.

skills.name: Advocacy and professional ethics
skills.whyItMatters: Oral presentation, client confidentiality, conflicts, and current bar enrolment requirements.
skills.practiceProject: Deliver a 3-minute argument on a fictional case.

skills.name: Subject knowledge
skills.whyItMatters: Build accurate command of the chosen school subject and curriculum.
skills.practiceProject: Create a concept map for one syllabus topic.

skills.name: Lesson planning
skills.whyItMatters: Learning objectives, lesson sequence, examples, formative checks, and inclusive activities.
skills.practiceProject: Design a 30-minute lesson plan.

skills.name: Classroom communication
skills.whyItMatters: Clear explanations, questioning, classroom routines, and constructive feedback.
skills.practiceProject: Prepare 5 questions at different difficulty levels.

skills.name: Assessment and inclusion
skills.whyItMatters: Rubrics, learner differences, accessibility, and reflective improvement.
skills.practiceProject: Create a simple rubric and an alternate activity.

skills.name: Indian polity and governance

skills.practiceProject: Make a one-page note on a constitutional institution.

skills.name: History, geography, and economy
skills.whyItMatters: Build integrated foundational knowledge and revise using maps, timelines, and data.
skills.practiceProject: Create a weekly revision sheet for one topic.

skills.name: Current affairs and source evaluation
skills.whyItMatters: Summarise developments, distinguish facts from opinion, and connect them to syllabus themes.
skills.practiceProject: Write a 200-word issue brief with sources.

skills.name: Answer writing and aptitude
skills.whyItMatters: Structured answers, reasoning, comprehension, time management, and mock-test review.
skills.practiceProject: Write and self-review one timed practice answer.

skills.name: General knowledge and reasoning
skills.whyItMatters: Practise current affairs, logical reasoning, quantitative aptitude, and comprehension.
skills.practiceProject: Complete a timed practice set and review errors.

skills.name: Fitness and conditioning

skills.practiceProject: Keep a gradual weekly fitness log suited to your current ability.

skills.name: Communication and conflict de-escalation

skills.practiceProject: Role-play a nonviolent conflict-resolution scenario.

skills.name: Law, procedure, and ethics
skills.whyItMatters: Learn the applicable recruitment syllabus, legal basics, rights, documentation, and accountability.
skills.practiceProject: Summarise a public-service ethics scenario.

skills.name: Electrical theory and safety
skills.whyItMatters: Voltage, current, resistance, power, circuits, isolation, PPE, and hazard awareness.

skills.name: Wiring and circuit diagrams
skills.whyItMatters: Read symbols, wiring diagrams, load concepts, earthing, and protective devices.
skills.practiceProject: Draw a simple lighting-circuit diagram for study.

skills.name: Tools and testing concepts
skills.whyItMatters: Identify tools and learn the purpose and safe handling principles of test instruments under supervision.
skills.practiceProject: Prepare a tool-identification and inspection checklist.

skills.name: Installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting
skills.whyItMatters: Follow applicable standards, inspect faults methodically, and practise only in supervised training.
skills.practiceProject: Create a fault-finding flowchart using a simulated circuit.

skills.name: Solar PV fundamentals
skills.whyItMatters: Sunlight-to-electricity basics, PV modules, inverters, and system components.
skills.practiceProject: Draw a labelled grid-connected solar system.

skills.name: Electrical safety and DC basics
skills.whyItMatters: Polarity, DC hazards, isolation, PPE, and safe work practices under qualified supervision.
skills.practiceProject: Identify safety checkpoints on a training diagram.

skills.name: System sizing and site assessment
skills.whyItMatters: Understand energy use, orientation, shading, basic sizing, and site constraints.
skills.practiceProject: Estimate a sample household’s daily energy needs.

skills.name: Installation, testing, and maintenance
skills.whyItMatters: Learn mounting, cable routing, inspection, performance monitoring, and maintenance documentation.
skills.practiceProject: Create a preventive-maintenance checklist from training guidance.

skills.name: Engineering mathematics and mechanics
skills.whyItMatters: Algebra, trigonometry, statics, forces, and material behaviour.
skills.practiceProject: Solve basic force and equilibrium problems.

skills.name: Engineering drawing and CAD
skills.whyItMatters: Read plans, dimensions, sections, scales, and use CAD for simple drawings.
skills.practiceProject: Draw a basic floor plan with dimensions.

skills.name: Construction materials and surveying
skills.whyItMatters: Understand concrete/steel basics, measurements, levelling, and site records.
skills.practiceProject: Prepare a sample quantity and measurement sheet.

skills.name: Structural and project fundamentals
skills.whyItMatters: Learn load concepts, codes awareness, estimation, scheduling, and safety under qualified guidance.
skills.practiceProject: Create a small project schedule and risk checklist.

skills.name: Engineering mathematics and mechanics
skills.whyItMatters: Mathematics, statics, dynamics, and strength-of-materials fundamentals.
skills.practiceProject: Solve a basic force and motion problem set.

skills.name: CAD and technical drawing
skills.whyItMatters: Orthographic views, dimensions, tolerances, and 3D modelling basics.
skills.practiceProject: Model a simple mechanical part in CAD.

skills.name: Manufacturing and materials
skills.whyItMatters: Material properties, machining, manufacturing processes, and quality basics.
skills.practiceProject: Compare two materials for a fictional component.

skills.name: Thermal systems and troubleshooting
skills.whyItMatters: Thermodynamics, fluid/heat concepts, measurement, and systematic fault analysis.
skills.practiceProject: Create a troubleshooting tree for a simple mechanism.

skills.name: Visual design fundamentals
skills.whyItMatters: Composition, hierarchy, typography, colour, spacing, and visual balance.
skills.practiceProject: Design a poster using a clear hierarchy.

skills.name: Design software workflow
skills.whyItMatters: Use vector and raster tools, layers, grids, export settings, and reusable assets.
skills.practiceProject: Create a logo set and social-media export pack.

skills.name: Branding and layout systems
skills.whyItMatters: Brand consistency, audience fit, layout systems, and basic print/digital constraints.
skills.practiceProject: Create a mini brand kit with colours and type styles.

skills.name: Portfolio and client communication
skills.whyItMatters: Brief interpretation, feedback rounds, file handoff, licensing awareness, and case-study presentation.
skills.practiceProject: Present a before/after case study with design rationale.

skills.name: Editing fundamentals
skills.whyItMatters: Timeline editing, pacing, continuity, story structure, and selecting usable takes.
skills.practiceProject: Edit a 30-second story from provided clips.

skills.name: Audio and colour basics
skills.whyItMatters: Dialogue cleanup, levels, music balance, colour correction, and consistent exports.
skills.practiceProject: Polish a short clip with clean audio and corrected colour.

skills.name: Motion graphics and titles
skills.whyItMatters: Keyframes, easing, typography animation, compositing basics, and readable titles.
skills.practiceProject: Create a 5-second animated title sequence.

skills.name: Delivery and client workflow
skills.whyItMatters: Aspect ratios, codecs, captions, versioning, feedback, and organised project files.
skills.practiceProject: Export the same edit for vertical and widescreen formats.

skills.name: Customer discovery and problem validation
skills.whyItMatters: Identify a target segment, interview potential customers, and test assumptions before building.
skills.practiceProject: Interview 5 potential customers and summarise evidence.

skills.name: Business model and pricing
skills.whyItMatters: Value proposition, revenue/cost structure, pricing hypotheses, and unit economics basics.
skills.practiceProject: Create a one-page business model and simple cost sheet.

skills.name: Marketing and sales
skills.whyItMatters: Positioning, outreach, customer conversations, conversion tracking, and retention basics.
skills.practiceProject: Run a small, low-cost validation campaign.

skills.name: Operations and financial discipline
skills.whyItMatters: Cash flow, record keeping, customer support, legal compliance awareness, and risk management.
skills.practiceProject: Build a 3-month cash-flow forecast with assumptions.
